description: Grundvattentillgång i små magasin (visningstjänst) is a dataset listed in Geodata Portal Sweden, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by resource.sgu.se. Groundwater supply in small reservoirs shows a calculation of groundwater supply for water supply in Sweden with a focus on small groundwater reservoirs. The calculation is based on a number of assumptions and a relatively general base material and is associated with uncertainties. Coverage: SE. The portal shows the English title as "Groundwater supply in small reservoirs (display service)" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://resources.geodata.se/codelist/metadata/anvandningsrestriktioner.xml#CC01.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geodata-se.
